data.name: Vengatesh
data.gender_notes: Vengatesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vengatesh is derived from the Tamil language and is a combination of two words - Ven (Lord) and Gatesh (Victory). This name is believed to represent the lord of victory who bestows power, protection, and success upon his devotees. The name Vengatesh carries the meaning “Lord of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Vengatesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Vengatesh is a tribute to Lord Murugan, who is believed to be the god of victory, love, and war. It is also believed that the name carries the power and blessings of Lord Shiva, who is the ultimate destroyer and the god of transformation.
data.etymology: Vengatesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vengatesh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
